t: This is the statue of Hans Sloane on Duke of York Square in Chelsea. It was made by the sculptor Simon Smith. Sir Hans Sloane was an Anglo-Irish physician, naturalist and collector. He left his collection of 71,000 items to the British nation, and that gift became the foundation of the British Museum, the British Library and the Natural History Museum. So a great deal of what you can see in London's museums and libraries traces back to the man shown here.
